theory: In the closed focal-insurgent assay, liquid organizational capital obeys the event-level stock-flow identity K(t)=K0+Y(t)-B(t), where Y is cumulative positive capital flow and B cumulative negative capital flow. The fitted recruitment/fielding multiplier boundary is treated as a proxy for this resource metabolism, not a fundamental law.

measurement.method: Advance exactly one scheduled event at a time using advance_until_limited(..., Some(1)); measure focal insurgent liquid capital immediately before and after every event.
measurement.positive_flow_Y: sum of positive event-level capital deltas
measurement.negative_flow_B: sum of absolute negative event-level capital deltas
measurement.early_runway_days: K30/max(early_net_burn_rate, epsilon) when net burn is positive; +infinity otherwise

primary_tests.capital_exhaustion_consistency: for trajectories whose organization deactivates with K<=numerical tolerance, Lambda_K reaches 1 within numerical tolerance at the exhaustion boundary
primary_tests.mechanistic_compression: AUC regret of early runway relative to a leave-one-seed-out logistic model using log recruitment_mult, log fielding_mult, log capital_mult <= 0.03

interpretation_guard: The stock-flow identity is exact by construction only for this closed synthetic assay. Predictive transport of an early-window runway rule across topology, scale, organization phenotype, and historical cases must be separately tested.
